source_full_text: No, I won't say it till I get the princess for my wife was the shepherd's answer. Now the princess was sitting on a little throne beside the king, her father, And she looked as sweet and lovely as a little golden dove. reference_text: 不，我不会说的，直到我娶了公主做妻子，这是牧羊人的回答。此刻，公主正坐在她父亲国王身旁的一张小王座上，她看起来像一只可爱的小金鸽子般甜美动人。当她听到牧羊人的话时，忍不住笑了起来。
